source: VERIFIED against photos in characters/common/ (deposited 2026-07-01, read directly by Claude). 17 cards found — close to the ~18 figure estimated via web search (BGG thread 'Analyzing the core cards of Dice Throne'), likely complete or missing at most 1. Shared identically across all heroes (each hero's box prints its own physical copies, card-back ID differs but text/effect is the same). actionTiming added 2026-07-01 from the same text already transcribed below (Roll Phase Action / Main Phase Action / Instant Action prefix).

cards.name: Six-It!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. Change the value of one of your dice to a 6.

cards.name: Better D!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. A chosen player may perform an additional Roll Attempt of up to five dice during their Defensive Roll Phase.

cards.name: Transference!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Transfer 1 status effect token from a chosen player to another chosen player.

cards.name: So Wild!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. Change the value of any one die.

cards.name: Vegas Baby!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Roll 1 die: Gain 1/2 the value as CP (rounded up).

cards.name: What Status Effects?
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Remove all status effect tokens from a chosen player.

cards.name: Get That Outta Here!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Remove a status effect token from a chosen player.

cards.name: Twice As Wild!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. Change the values of any two dice.

cards.name: Try, Try Again!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. You or a chosen teammate may re-roll up to two dice (can be the same die twice in a row or two different dice).

cards.name: Tip It!
cards.text: Instant Action. Increase or decrease any die by the value of 1 (a value of 1 cannot be decreased and a value of 6 cannot be increased).

cards.name: Samesies!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. Change the value of one of your dice to be identical to the value of another one of your dice (that was rolled within the same phase and for the same purpose).

cards.name: Helping Hand!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. Select one of your opponent's dice and force them to re-roll it.

cards.name: One More Time!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. A chosen player may perform an additional Roll Attempt of up to five dice during their Offensive Roll Phase.

cards.name: Not This Time!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. A chosen player prevents 6 incoming dmg.
